email.subject: Coral Hair Studio: a couple of quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Tom,

I checked Coral Hair Studio's site. Two things likely costing you bookings: it doesn't work properly on mobile, where most local searches happen, and there's no click-to-call button, so people have to hunt for your number instead of just tapping to ring the salon. On top of that, there's no online booking, no reviews showing, and the page title doesn't say "hair salon in Harbor Falls," which hurts how you show up in search.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what's going on, no obligation.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
Northlight Web
